raceWin: First across the line! The tires send their regards.
A winner is you. Please stay humble for at least four seconds.
That was fast. The speed limit called, and we told it you'd call back.
raceLose: Podium or not, that was a lovely drive. Mostly.
Not the win this time. The road will be here tomorrow, and so will the rematch.
busted: Looks like somebody got a ride in the back of a cruiser. Chin up, a fine is only money.
Busted! Don't worry, the Harbor Patrol listens to this station too.
Lesson of the day: blue lights mean slow down. We say this with love.
escaped: And they've lost you! Smooth driving. Somewhere, a cruiser is very confused.
The Harbor Patrol has gone quiet. Take a breath, and maybe use your turn signal.
You got away. We didn't see anything. We're a radio station.
wreck: That car has seen better days. And honestly, better afternoons.
Crunch. That was a sound effect we did not add.
Buckle up, buttercup. That one needs a very long nap at the garage.
derbyWin: The last car running wins the derby! A round of applause, from a radio, which is not very loud.
Demolition champion! Your trophy is a bag of smoke and a brand new dent.
taxi: Another happy passenger delivered. Tip jar status: hopeful.
Fare complete. The meter says thank you, and so do we.
delivery: Package delivered! Somewhere, a doorstep is smiling.
Signed, sealed, and delivered. Mostly still sealed.
plow: The roads are clear! Plow drivers are the quiet heroes of every snowy morning.
Nice work out there. The snow has been told to stay off the road. It's thinking about it.
fish: Now that is a catch! The fish would like a word, but it's out of breath.
Big fish alert. Someone will tell this story for years, and the fish will get bigger every time.
duckSet: Every lost duck is home! The rubber duck league is very proud of you.
receiptSet: Every last bridge receipt, collected! The town's filing cabinet weeps with joy.
photo: Picture perfect! That one is going straight on the fridge.
coop: A crew job well done! Teamwork makes the dream work, and the trucks run.
Everybody pitched in, and it shows. Pass the congratulations around.
stage: A new stage of the town project is open! Take the long way round and have a look.
Port Calamity just got a little nicer. Scissors up, everybody.
jump: Airtime! The car is now officially an airplane. Briefly.
That's a big jump. Nobody check the suspension.
eventSoon: Heads up, Port Calamity. Something fun starts in town in about a minute. Hurry along.
snow: It's snowing hard out there. Slow down, and maybe hum something cozy.
The snow is really coming down. Drive like the road is a freshly iced cake.
